cmd: sitelooper do "Sign in to EspoCRM with username «redacted» and password «redacted». Then go to the Opportunities list and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen. Do not modify anything." --session fwec1-n1 --json --timeout 300 --max-turns 30

sitelooper do "Create a new Opportunity in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = 'fwec1-n1 Bench Opportunity'; Account = 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions or the select dialog, not just type it; note other accounts have similar names so pick the exact one); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500 (default currency); Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions or select dialog, exact match); Description = 'Bench opportunity for run fwec1-n1'. Save the record. Then verify by reopening the record and report the values shown for Name, Account, Stage, Amount, Close Date, Assigned User, and Description, plus the record ID from the page address (#Opportunity/view/<id>)." --session fwec1-n1 --json --timeout 600 --max-turns 40

sitelooper do "The EspoCRM create-Opportunity form is currently open at #Opportunity/create with Name 'fwec1-n1 Bench Opportunity', Account 'Bench Account', Stage 'Negotiation', Amount 12500, Assigned User 'Bench Assignee', and Description 'Bench opportunity for run fwec1-n1' already filled, but the Close Date field is empty. Set the Close Date to 2026-12-31 — use the date picker popup (click the field, navigate/select the date 31 December 2026) or type the date and press Enter so the value commits to the field. Confirm the field now shows 2026-12-31. Then click Save and wait for the record page to load. Report the record ID from the address (#Opportunity/view/<id>) and the values shown on the record page for Name, Account, Stage, Amount, Close Date, Assigned User and Description." --session fwec1-n1 --json --timeout 600 --max-turns 40

sitelooper do "On the EspoCRM record page for the opportunity 'fwec1-n1 Bench Opportunity' (currently open at #Opportunity/view/6ab1b02db0b8615b9), find the Stream panel and write a post whose text includes 'fwec1-n1' (for example: 'Bench stream post for run fwec1-n1'). Submit it and verify the post appears in the Stream. Report the exact text of the post as shown in the Stream." --session fwec1-n1 --json --timeout 600 --max-turns 30

sitelooper do "Final verification on the EspoCRM opportunity 'fwec1-n1 Bench Opportunity' at #Opportunity/view/6ab1b02db0b8615b9. Reload/reopen the record page and report exactly what is shown for: Name, Account, Stage, Amount, Close Date (click the pencil/edit icon on the Close Date field to reveal the underlying stored date value in the input, then cancel without saving), Assigned User, and the record ID in the address. Also confirm the Stream still shows the post containing 'fwec1-n1' and quote its text. Do not change anything." --session fwec1-n1 --json --timeout 600 --max-turns 30
